title: A Homecoming for the Prom
author: Tamsin Dunmore
blurb: Rosalind Thornbury, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
